description: Self-hosted Renovate (.github/workflows/renovate.yml). See CONTRIBUTING.md, 'Dependencies and licences'.

Automerge: files without a code owner (lockfiles, docker/base-images.env), workflows (patch, minor, digest, pin) and development or optional dependencies (patch, minor). The app is a bypass actor of the code owner ruleset for pull requests only; the required checks stay. Never automerged: majors, renovate.json, CODEOWNERS, .releaserc.json, .github/release-tools (CONTRIBUTING.md, 'Dependencies and licences').

Renovate merges by itself once every check is green (platformAutomerge is off: the rulesets do not require every check). Two runs a day (renovate.yml): a merge happens in the run after the checks finished.

customManagers.description: Images pinned by tag and digest in the test and scan scripts (PostgreSQL, Playwright, Trivy).
Tools pinned inside workflow files: gitleaks and the Renovate image (by digest), commitlint and the npm licence checker, pytest.

packageRules.description: Docker images: two days. Docker Hub gives every tag a release timestamp (tag_last_pushed), so a re-pushed tag restarts the wait for its digest update (docs: key-concepts/minimum-release-age, 'digest updates').
GHCR and MCR return no release timestamps; with timestamp-required their updates would never be offered. They sit in owned files (scripts, workflows) and never automerge.
Composer: three days, as npm.
npm: three days, the window in which npm still allows an unpublish.
GitHub Actions: pinned by SHA with the version comment; a workflow change, so ci(deps).
Everything pinned in a workflow is a workflow change: ci(deps), reviewed by the maintainer.
The semantic-release toolchain of release.yml is CI tooling, not part of the image.
The documentation website (website/) is published to GitHub Pages, not part of the image: one group, chore(deps).
conventional-changelog-conventionalcommits 10 empties the changelog with release-notes-generator 14 unless conventional-changelog-writer is overridden.
prBodyNotes: Version 10 needs `"overrides": { "conventional-changelog-writer": "9.2.0" }` in `.github/release-tools/package.json` (semantic-release/release-notes-generator#1021); check a dry run of `Release` before merging.

packageRules.description: The browsers of scripts/e2e/run.sh and the test runner of package-lock.json must be one Playwright release.
vite is an override onto vite-plus-core, and vite-plus pins vitest exactly (1.7.0 needs vitest 5.1.0, core 8.3.8000): they move together with the vitest packages.
commitlint CLI and config are released together.
PostgreSQL of CI, the dev stack and the smoke tests: one pin.
A security fix of a dependency that ships in the image releases a patch.
Automerge: base image pins (docker/base-images.env has no code owner).
Automerge: updates inside the declared range change only composer.lock or a package-lock.json (no code owner).

conventional-changelog-writer is an override of .github/release-tools/package.json, pinned to 9.2.0 on purpose: conventional-changelog-conventionalcommits 10 empties the changelog with release-notes-generator 14 otherwise (semantic-release/release-notes-generator#1021, merged in #123). Renovate sees the override as a dependency and offered 9.3.0 (#159). Lift this when the issue is fixed upstream.

Automerge: updates pinned inside workflows (GitHub Actions, images, tools). The app bypasses the code owner rule on pull requests only; the required checks still hold. Majors are excluded by the rule below, renovate.json and CODEOWNERS are not managed by Renovate, .github/release-tools has no workflow file.

Automerge: development and optional dependencies, patch and minor. The release toolchain (.github/release-tools) has no such dependency type and never merges by itself, apart from its lockfile rule above.

Lock file maintenance is merged by hand: it has no release timestamps, so the wait cannot hold it back (Renovate docs, key-concepts/minimum-release-age, 'lockFileMaintenance updates'), and with timestamp-required its renovate/stability-days check stays pending.
Majors are merged by hand.
Files shared with main come in through main (CONTRIBUTING.md, 'Workflow and repository files go to main first'); a milestone branch gets them with the sync pull request.
